tasks.text: Repair a Python CSV importer that skips quoted multiline fields, add regression tests, and run the focused test file.
Implement cursor pagination for a TypeScript HTTP endpoint and verify boundary behavior with automated tests.
Find the race in a background job queue, write a test that reproduces it, and apply the smallest safe fix.
Correct a SQL migration whose rollback loses indexes, then exercise both upgrade and downgrade paths locally.
Add cancellation support to a Go worker pool without leaking goroutines and run the package tests.
Fix a React form that submits stale state after rapid edits and cover the behavior with a component test.
Update a Rust parser to reject duplicate keys while preserving useful error locations, then run its test suite.
Diagnose why a Java cache returns expired values under concurrent access and add a regression test for the fix.
Make a shell command wrapper preserve child exit codes and stderr, with tests for success and failure cases.
Repair a Kotlin JSON decoder that confuses missing fields with explicit nulls and verify both cases.
Explain photosynthesis to a twelve-year-old using one analogy, then ask two questions that check understanding.
Create a forty-minute lesson plan that introduces fractions through paper folding and includes an exit ticket.
Show a student where their quadratic-equation solution went wrong without supplying the final answer immediately.
Compare mitosis and meiosis in a table suitable for an introductory biology revision sheet.
Write a short practice set on subject-verb agreement with answers and one-line explanations.
Turn a chapter about plate tectonics into spaced-repetition prompts ordered from recall to application.
Explain why correlation does not prove causation using a school attendance example and no statistical jargon.
Design a simple classroom experiment for evaporation that states variables, controls, and expected observations.
Give constructive feedback on a history paragraph whose claim is clear but whose evidence is weak.
Teach the difference between area and perimeter through a worked example and one independent exercise.
Compare two savings accounts using their stated rates and fees, and show the one-year arithmetic without recommending a provider.
Build a monthly household budget from the supplied income and bills, leaving a clearly labeled contingency amount.
Explain how credit-card minimum payments affect payoff time using a small hypothetical balance.
Calculate simple and compound interest on the same fictional deposit and explain why the totals differ.
Organize a list of expenses into fixed, variable, and discretionary categories without giving investment advice.
Estimate the emergency fund implied by three months of listed essential expenses and state the assumptions.
Compare the total stated costs of renting and buying a laptop under two fictional payment plans.
Check a loan amortization example for arithmetic errors and return a corrected first-three-payment table.
Explain inflation's effect on purchasing power with a hypothetical grocery basket over two years.
Turn a fictional payslip into a plain-language breakdown of gross pay, deductions, and net pay.
Read the supplied lease and produce a memo listing renewal dates, notice periods, and the clause supporting each item.
Compare two policy drafts, preserve their heading structure, and write a change log with section references.
Extract decisions and owners from meeting minutes into a formatted action register, then verify the saved document.
Revise a grant proposal for consistency while keeping all tables, citations, and quoted figures unchanged.
Turn interview notes into a concise candidate summary that separates direct evidence from the reviewer's interpretation.
Create an accessible handbook page from the supplied procedure, retaining warnings and numbered steps.
Review a contract appendix and produce a requirements checklist with exact source-page references.
Consolidate three project briefs into one document and flag contradictions instead of silently resolving them.
Convert a dense committee report into a two-page briefing while preserving every recorded vote and dissent.
Audit a user guide against a supplied style sheet, apply the required edits, and verify the exported file.
Find primary sources on urban tree-canopy measurement and summarize how each study defines canopy coverage.
Compare official guidance on household battery recycling across three jurisdictions and cite each rule.
Trace the origin of a quoted public-health statistic and report whether the original source supports the claim.
Review recent papers on retrieval evaluation and tabulate the datasets, metrics, and stated limitations.
Investigate the historical dates given for a local landmark using archives, noting unresolved conflicts.
Compare public specifications for three open file formats and identify differences in metadata support.
Find official accessibility requirements for captions and produce a cited checklist for recorded lectures.
Check whether a popular claim about sleep duration matches the conclusions of the cited clinical guideline.
Summarize primary evidence on heat-pump performance in cold climates and distinguish measurements from projections.
Compare official open-data licensing terms and identify which permit commercial redistribution with attribution.
Turn the supplied status notes into a weekly update with progress, blockers, owners, and due dates.
Draft an agenda from five submitted topics, allot forty-five minutes, and put decision items first.
Reconcile two attendee lists, remove duplicates, and save a clean list with unmatched entries flagged.
Prepare a handover note that maps ongoing tasks to owners, deadlines, and the location of supporting files.
Convert a shared inbox summary into a priority queue without inventing urgency or deadlines.
Create a room-booking schedule from the requests and highlight the two time conflicts for review.
Format a short operating procedure from rough notes and add a revision table without changing the steps.
Build a decision log from the supplied email thread with dates, participants, and links to source messages.
Summarize quarterly objectives into a one-page review that distinguishes completed work from planned work.
Create a fair interview schedule from availability windows and clearly list candidates who could not be placed.
Plan five vegetarian packed lunches that share ingredients and can be prepared in under an hour.
Write a polite message asking a neighbor to lower late-night music without sounding accusatory.
Create a weekend packing checklist for a rainy city trip with one formal dinner.
Suggest a simple rotation for four people sharing kitchen cleaning duties over one month.
Turn a list of pantry items into two dinner ideas and name any missing staple for each.
Draft a brief invitation for a casual board-game evening that asks guests about dietary needs.
Make a thirty-minute morning routine from the supplied tasks, including five minutes of buffer.
Help divide six moving-day jobs among three friends based on the listed restrictions.
Write instructions for watering houseplants during a one-week absence using the provided plant list.
Create a low-effort study-break plan for an afternoon with three ninety-minute work blocks.
Determine which of four statements can all be true given the supplied ordering constraints, and show the deduction.
Calculate how many tiles a stepped pattern needs at stage twenty and derive the general rule.
Find the shortest valid delivery route under the listed one-way and time-window constraints.
Check whether the conclusion follows from three quantified premises and provide a counterexample if it does not.
Solve a mixture problem with two concentrations, showing the conservation equation and a unit check.
Infer the missing value in a number grid and explain why the same rule fits every row.
Schedule five talks across two rooms while respecting speaker conflicts and minimizing unused gaps.
Evaluate a probability argument about drawing colored tokens without replacement and correct its first faulty step.
Work out which person owns each bicycle from the supplied clues and show a compact elimination table.
Determine the break-even quantity for two fictional pricing plans and test the result on both sides of the boundary.
Inspect the supplied image files, rename them from their visible labels, and produce a mapping of old to new names.
Search the local notes for unresolved decisions, group them by project, and save a checked Markdown report.
Read a directory of receipts, extract date and total, and flag files whose values cannot be verified.
Run the provided command-line program on all fixtures and summarize failures with their exit codes.
Compare the metadata of duplicate-looking photos and move no files until a hash-based duplicate list is complete.
Inspect a web page and its linked policy PDF, then answer the question with links to both sources.
Extract tables from the supplied files, combine matching columns, and verify the final row count.
Check a folder of audio transcripts against filenames and save a report of missing or mismatched items.
Query the local database for overdue records and export only the requested fields to a new CSV file.
Open the supplied presentation, find slides with broken image references, and list their slide numbers.
Trace every change to the eligibility rule across the supplied policy archive and cite the effective date of each revision.
Compare all versions of a software manual and list commands whose documented behavior changed.
Build a chronology of a research program from annual reports, linking each milestone to its source section.
Find inconsistent definitions of the same term across a collection of standards and quote the relevant clauses.
Summarize recurring customer complaints across several years of support logs without losing low-frequency safety issues.
Identify all obligations assigned to one department across the supplied handbook and its appendices.
Review a long legislative record and map each final provision to the amendment that introduced it.
Compare a full set of course catalogs and report prerequisites that changed without a matching course description update.
Analyze a multi-year incident archive for repeated contributing factors and cite every supporting record.
Reconcile names, dates, and totals across a collection of meeting packets and flag unresolved conflicts.
Clean a membership workbook, preserve formulas, remove exact duplicate rows, and verify the final totals.
Build a monthly cash-flow sheet from the supplied transactions with formulas and a category summary.
Repair broken cross-sheet references in a grade book and confirm that weighted scores recalculate correctly.
Create a pivot summary and chart of library visits by branch and month from the source workbook.
Merge two inventory sheets by product code and flag conflicting descriptions instead of overwriting them.
Add data validation and conditional formatting to a booking tracker while keeping existing formulas intact.
Calculate survey response rates by group in a new summary tab and check the denominator for missing entries.
Turn raw time entries into a weekly utilization report with formulas that remain correct when rows are added.
Audit a price-comparison workbook for inconsistent units and create a normalized cost column.
Create a loan schedule from the stated terms and verify the ending balance against rounding drift.
Rewrite this reminder in a polite tone while keeping it under thirty words.
Correct the spelling and punctuation in a three-sentence notice without changing its meaning.
Shorten the supplied update to two sentences and retain both dates.
Turn four rough bullet points into one clear paragraph with no new claims.
Suggest a specific subject line for the supplied scheduling email.
Change a formal announcement into friendly plain language while preserving the deadline.
Remove repeated information from a short biography and keep the result under eighty words.
Rewrite an error message so it states what happened and the next action in one sentence.
Convert a passive two-sentence instruction into direct active voice.
Make the supplied thank-you note warmer without adding praise that was not in the original.
